source_refs.interpretation: the generic enum Packet source contract

statement: Deliver a pure VSCore 0.3 source implementation. Compass has exactly north, south and center. Packet has direction:Compass and amount:Int. The adjust entry returns a Packet preserving direction, adding two to amount when direction is north and subtracting three otherwise. The domain contains every Compass alternative and every mathematical integer; a Packet with north and zero is a witness. Deliver adjust in program.vscore.json with typed total evaluation, deterministic results, preserved inputs, no external I/O or floating point, pure data and the restricted runtime. These source requirements are independently required and are also part of the value guarantee. This is a restricted source contract.
